title: Tenable plugin supported upstream versions
description: Which upstream versions the tenable plugin is known to work with, and on what evidence (req-tenable-upstream-versions). The probe reads this file to give each run one verdict. The README table is generated from it. Each range must have both a lower and an upper bound. An entry claiming observed evidence must name the date and the recorded response it rests on.

description.description: What this file is, for a reader who opens it cold.

hard_floor.description: The Security Center version below which the credential cannot work at all (no API-key authentication). A probed version below it ends the run with an error.

entries.description: The supported ranges, each with its evidence level.

description.description: One sentence saying what this entry claims.

product.description: The upstream product: Tenable Security Center, or the pyTenable client library.

supported.description: A bounded specifier: a lower bound (>=) and an upper bound (<) separated by a comma, or one exact version (==). An open-ended range is refused.

evidence.description: documented: read from vendor documentation; designed: this plugin's own decision; observed: seen in a recorded response.

observed_on.description: observed entries only: the date the recording was made, YYYY-MM-DD.

recording.description: observed entries only: the recorded response the claim rests on (a reviewed fixture path).
